references.text: Describes the regulations for the burnt offering (הָעֹלָה) that Aaron follows 'according to the ordinance' (כַּמִּשְׁפָּט) in Leviticus 9:16
Uses the same expression 'according to the ordinance' (כַּמִּשְׁפָּט) to describe how sacrifices are to be performed
Earlier in the same chapter, Aaron offers his own burnt offering, which prepares him to offer the people's burnt offering in verse 16
God's command regarding the daily burnt offering that was to be presented on the altar
Detailed instructions for the daily burnt offering that is to be presented according to the ordinance
The book of Hebrews explains how the Old Testament burnt offerings pointed forward to Christ's perfect sacrifice
